study.question: Does the persistent local coarse-sign averaging deficit arise partly from averaging adapter outputs before nonlinear prediction, rather than from useful directed coarse information itself?
study.hypothesis: Observation: r0074 widening16->64 worsened even and signed AUC and left signed-minus-even gaps0.00183623 and0.00201071 respectively; simple click-adapter width did not rescue the even readout. Mechanism hypothesis: early averaging can cancel view-specific residual interactions before the tower; probability averaging after a common nonlinear tower may retain useful even nonlinear interactions at identical learned capacity. A4B common support population isolates the readout location within each sign treatment. A late-averaging rescue would weaken a claim that oriented coarse information is necessary, while lack of rescue only bounds this implementation. This is provisional and local; supplied order utility and global permutation invariance remain broader questions.

study.proposed_difference: A2x2 factorial: coarse_view_treatment reflect/duplicate crossed with averaging_location adapter/prediction. All cells compute signed, reflected and axis click-adapter calls, form two selected corrections, then run the click tower once on4B rows [mean,mean,first,second]. Select the mean probability from early-averaged or separate-view rows. Common native support holds normalization populations fixed across averaging locations at common state. No added learned parameters, loss hook, event permutation or new information. The extra tower rows cost compute; utility is judged against the unchanged incumbent separately.
predictions: Within reflect treatment, prediction averaging improves validation click AUC over adapter averaging; the corresponding duplicate location effect is near numerical zero.

Primary interaction I=(A_RP-A_RA)-(A_DP-A_DA)>=0.0003, with recovery I/G>=0.25 only when G=A_DA-A_RA>=0.0005, motivates later paired-seed repetition. These practical thresholds do not establish significance.

At common native state, reflect outputs are invariant to reflecting only the click-adapter coarse argument; duplicate outputs can retain sign sensitivity. The model is not globally permutation invariant.
All four have source-predicted32192421 parameters, but4B click towers increase execution cost relative to r0074; actual equal-work and utility-cost comparisons require host measurements.
falsifiers: If I<0.0003 or the qualifying gap recovery is below0.25, this tested averaging-location explanation lacks practically useful support. Equal or worse late averaging is retained as a negative result.
If duplicate early/late fail native prediction/gradient/state parity or their full AUC differs by>0.00001, diagnose numerics/implementation before attributing a location effect.
If reflection fails the local coarse sign-invariance check at common nonzero state, the intended quotient is not implemented; do not interpret a quality result as its mechanism.
Even a late rescue cannot establish whole-history order dispensability; if performance remains below contemporaneous signed control or incumbent, state the residual gap and cost.
alternative_explanations: The signed coarse moment contains useful directed information that neither local quotient can recover.
The late model changes its learned representation or implicit optimization through native batch-moment coupling; one AUC gain cannot uniquely establish nonlinear interaction preservation.
One-epoch optimization or readout inductive bias, rather than insufficient mathematical expressivity, may explain the earlier width null.
Native4B normalization support differs from historical B runs; only contemporaneous location comparisons share that support.
Validation adaptation, shared-user dependence, finite precision and seed variation can mimic small improvements; exact replays are not independent seeds.

variants.note:
Cell reflect_prediction: coarse_view_treatment=reflect, averaging_location=prediction; SHA256=83d50c4e2d6f9d99cbf6af70ed86ba9e407088665734dc4a1653de79783b45e5.

Prospective implementation, no new training or validation result. Reproduce by resolving task://t-001, run://r-001 and workspace://w-001, then the authorized host loads proposal.json and instantiates each standalone Model(feature_map, **variant.config) under the frozen runner. No training CLI is exposed in this phase; no local training/installations or withheld access occurred. Syntax reproduction: python3 -m py_compile reflect_prediction.py reflect_adapter.py duplicate_prediction.py duplicate_adapter.py.

Implementation: both signs and the pivot-axis adapter are evaluated in every cell. Select pair (positive,negative) for reflect or (positive,positive) for duplicate. Compute their FP32 mean, cast back to inherited adapter dtype, and build click tower rows [mean,mean,first,second]. One ordinary 4B tower call in both training/eval gives common native Dice support to early and late readouts at common state. Early selects the probability mean of the first two rows; late selects the last two. Both readouts execute in all cells; zero terms retain the unselected graph. Batch-statistic coupling means unselected tower support rows can still carry gradients; do not assert they have zero gradient. Auxiliary towers remain B and the BCE objective remains the sum of four unweighted losses on returned probabilities. All event fields, actions, task masks, padding, target and 100-event restrictions are untouched. Reflection changes only the coarse moment fed to the click adapter, not whole-history order. Other routes retain local/curvature/joint and axis information.

Local checks passed: compilation; literal CONFIG agrees with constructor defaults; all four ASTs agree after two-default/CONFIG normalization;21 inherited nonconstructor/nonforward helper ASTs match r0074 signed_bridge; removing only new validation/nonlearned switches recovers its constructor AST, hence no learned module or initialization change is introduced. Source import/I/O checks and proposal structure checks are preparation, not host validation. Torch and jsonschema are absent; no native forward/backward, data digest verification, optimizer step or GPU resource measurement is claimed. Prior receipts report candidate_diagnostics.status=not_requested; old note checklists are not successful diagnostics.

Required host preflight: validate pinned parquet/data identity and frozen FeatureMap/label order, prefix/action visibility and historical task-mask semantics. Test finite four [B,1] outputs, default BCE/backward and sparse/dense ownership in FP32/BF16 on empty/singleton/2/9/10/11/99/100 histories, partial blocks, noncontiguous masks, batch size1 and remainder batches; perturb invalid fields/masks outside eligibility; ensure current target action exclusion and caller input immutability. Check device/checkpoint roundtrip and reordered labels. Use nonzero click adapter and context-output weights: verify click row groups [mean,mean,first,second], one 4B tower call and one Dice counter update per forward, one B call per auxiliary tower, identical learned state and RNG after construction. At common state reflect early/late must produce identical full tower rows and running-buffer updates; only selection/loss derivatives differ. Duplicate early/late must agree in predictions, source/parameter gradients, buffers and one optimizer step within explicit precision tolerances (FP32 atol1e-6/rtol1e-5; BF16 atol2e-3/rtol2e-2 initially, report maxima and justify any revision before comparison). Duplicate training need not exactly match the B-sized ancestor: native unbiased running-variance correction differs at4B. At copied common nonzero state, flip ONLY the primary adapter coarse input: reflect early/late must exchange the final two view groups and preserve final predictions; duplicate is expected to remain sign-sensitive. Do not call this whole-model order invariance. Verify all inherited auxiliary gradient gates and ordinary native batch-moment gradients, including support-row coupling. Failures consume budget and remain in receipts; do not silently modify the frozen host recipe to pass them.

Report primary full validation click AUC/Logloss and all four tasks, auxiliary mean separately; total/embedding/dense parameters, allocated GPU seconds, wall/train/inference time, examples processed, peak memory, examples/sec and model batch p50/p95 latency. Expected parameter counts from source are32192421/31793216/399205 in all four cells, pending host counting. Equal parameters and prescribed work are not measured equal compute. Compare to baseline-din, unchanged utility g0-r0052-block_nonlinear_transfer and r0074 signed/even bridges. Report quality/cost frontier; a more costly recovery below incumbent is mechanism evidence only, not a preferred deployment model.

Predeclared analysis: A_RP=reflect_prediction,A_RA=reflect_adapter,A_DP=duplicate_prediction,A_DA=duplicate_adapter. Primary attribution L_R=A_RP-A_RA, numerical/control effect L_D=A_DP-A_DA, interaction I=L_R-L_D. A practically interesting location rescue requires I>=0.0003 and, only if G=A_DA-A_RA>=0.0005, I/G>=0.25. These are decision thresholds, not significance. Duplicate AUC disagreement>0.00001 or native parity failure invalidates the clean location attribution pending diagnostics. Report both signed-reference gaps and absolute incumbent gap even if rescue occurs. A_RP within0.0002 of contemporaneous signed duplicate with compatible paired uncertainty is a recovery candidate, not equivalence established by one seed. Failure to improve rejects this tested averaging-location implementation as the explanation; it does not prove event order indispensable.
